debug.description: Enable debugging mode. Warning: May reveal sensitive information like entered pass phrases.

enhanced.description: Ask for timeouts and insurance. Not fully supported in all implementations.

no_global_grab.description: Grab keyboard only when window is focused. Use for debugging to avoid locking X session.

parent_wid.description: Window ID of the parent window for positioning the pinentry dialog.

display.description: X display string (e.g., :0) to connect to the X server.

lc_ctype.description: LC_CTYPE locale value for character classification.

lc_messages.description: LC_MESSAGES locale value for message translation.
